label: Gmail / Google Workspace
help: Use an app password, not your normal password: Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords. One-click Google connection is coming soon.

label: Zoho Mail (company domain, India)
help: Turn on IMAP in Zoho Mail → Settings → Mail Accounts → IMAP Access. If you use two-factor login, create an app password under Security → App Passwords.

label: Zoho Mail (personal, India)
help: Turn on IMAP in Zoho Mail → Settings → Mail Accounts → IMAP Access. If you use two-factor login, create an app password under Security → App Passwords.

label: Zoho Mail (outside India)
help: Use imap.zoho.com for personal accounts. Turn on IMAP in Zoho Mail settings first.

label: GoDaddy Workspace Email
help: For GoDaddy's older Workspace Email. If your GoDaddy email is 'Microsoft 365 from GoDaddy', choose Outlook / Microsoft 365 instead.

label: Rediffmail Pro / Enterprise
help: Use your full email address as the username. IMAP may need to be turned on by your Rediff administrator.

label: Hostinger
help: Use your full email address and mailbox password.

label: cPanel / website hosting email
help: Usually mail.yourdomain.com. Find the exact server under 'Email Accounts → Connect Devices' in your hosting control panel.

label: Outlook / Microsoft 365
help: Microsoft no longer allows password sign-in for most mailboxes. One-click Microsoft connection is coming soon.

label: Other (IMAP)
help: Ask your email provider or IT person for the IMAP server name. Port 993 with SSL is the most common.
